title: CDC Finds Key Drivers of Youth Health Issues
discussion_signal: The discussion highlights improvements in several youth mental-health and dietary indicators while emphasizing persistent sleep, physical-activity, digital-behavior, and suicide-risk concerns. It frames adolescent health as an upstream environment problem rather than a single individual behavior problem.
linked_research_question: How can youth health improve on some measures while sleep, activity, digital exposure, and mental-health risks remain uneven?
limits: The post summarizes national survey findings rather than subgroup microdata
Self-reported youth behaviors are not direct clinical outcomes
The discussion cannot establish which interventions caused observed changes
